<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#11150f">
<title>A Vila | Central de Quizzes</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#10140f;--panel:#1a2118;--muted:#b8c1b1;--text:#f3f4eb;--gold:#d7bd7b;--line:#34402f}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
.hero-image{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:auto;max-width:60%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center right;z-index:0}.hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,13,9,.98) 0%,rgba(8,13,9,.88) 34%,rgba(8,13,9,.35) 68%,rgba(8,13,9,.08) 100%);z-index:1}.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:760px}.nav{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:0;left:0;right:0;padding:24px max(7vw,24px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.logo{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.08em}.navlinks{display:flex;gap:22px}.navlinks button{background:none;border:0;color:#ddd;cursor:pointer;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero{min-height:78vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:70px 24px;background:#080b08}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:130px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--bg))}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:720px}.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif}
h1{font-size:clamp(3.5rem,9vw,7rem);line-height:.9;margin:18px 0 24px;font-weight:normal;letter-spacing:-.04em}h1 span{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hero p{font:17px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#e0e5dc;max-width:580px;margin:auto}.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:#171a12;background:var(--gold);padding:14px 22px;text-decoration:none;font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.btn:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--gold)}
main{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:25px 24px 80px}.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin:18px 0 26px}.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem);font-weight:normal;margin:0}.section-head p{font:13px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);max-width:360px;line-height:1.5}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:17px}.card{position:relative;min-height:310px;border:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel);display:flex;align-items:end;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);isolation:isolate;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s;cursor:pointer}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--gold)}.card img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:0;filter:saturate(.7);transition:transform .5s}.card:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}.card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 5%,rgba(8,12,8,.35) 35%,rgba(8,12,8,.97));z-index:1}.card-body{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:20px}.num{font:11px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em}.card h3{font-size:23px;font-weight:normal;margin:9px 0}.card p{font:12px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;color:#d0d7cc;margin:0}.tag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #75816c;color:#e4e8dc;padding:5px 8px;margin-top:14px;font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.quiz-area{margin-top:70px;padding:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2319,#131811);display:none}.quiz-area.active{display:block}.quiz-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center}.quiz-top h2{font-weight:normal;font-size:2rem;margin:0}.quiz-top small{font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--gold)}
.question{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,3vw,2rem);line-height:1.35;margin:30px 0 20px}.answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.answer{padding:16px;text-align:left;color:var(--text);background:#20291e;border:1px solid #3b4936;cursor:pointer;font:14px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif}.answer:hover{border-color:var(--gold)}.answer.selected{border-color:var(--gold);background:#343c29}.answer.correct{border-color:#9dbb7d;background:#263923}.answer.wrong{border-color:#bd8270;background:#3a2520}
.quiz-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;margin-top:22px}.progress{height:3px;background:#394233;margin-top:20px}.progress span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--gold);transition:width .25s}.feedback{font:13px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);min-height:20px;margin-top:14px}.notice{padding:15px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);background:#292b20;color:#e8dfc7;font:13px/1.6 Arial,sans-serif;margin:18px 0}
.ranking{margin-top:80px}.ranking-box{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel)}.rank-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr 100px;padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:12px;font:13px Arial,sans-serif}.rank-row.head{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.rank-number{color:var(--gold);font-weight:bold}
.auth{display:none;position:fixed;z-index:30;inset:0;background:rgba(5,8,6,.82);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}.auth.active{display:flex}.auth-box{width:min(430px,100%);background:#182018;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:30px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0008}.auth-box h2{font-weight:normal;font-size:30px;margin:0 0 10px}.auth-box p{font:13px/1.6 Arial;color:var(--muted)}.auth-box input{width:100%;padding:13px;margin:6px 0;background:#20291e;border:1px solid #3b4936;color:white;outline:none}.auth-actions{display:flex;gap:10px}.auth-msg{font:12px Arial;color:var(--muted);min-height:18px;margin-top:10px}
.footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px;text-align:center;color:#929d8b;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em}
@media(max-width:900px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:560px){.navlinks{gap:8px}.navlinks button{font-size:9px}.hero{min-height:70vh;padding:55px 22px}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.card{min-height:250px}.card-body{padding:13px}.card h3{font-size:18px}.card p{font-size:11px}.section-head{display:block}.section-head p{margin-top:10px}.quiz-area{padding:18px}.answers{grid-template-columns:1fr}.quiz-top h2{font-size:1.5rem}.rank-row{grid-template-columns:45px 1fr 70px}}
@media(max-width:700px){.hero{min-height:82vh;padding:90px 20px 40px}.hero-image{right:50%;transform:translateX(50%);height:100%;max-width:100%;opacity:.72}.hero-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,13,9,.82),rgba(8,13,9,.62) 45%,rgba(8,13,9,.94))}.hero-content{max-width:520px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <div class="logo">A VILA</div>
  <div class="navlinks">
    <button onclick="goQuizzes()">QUIZZES</button>
    <button onclick="goRanking()">RANKING</button>
    <button onclick="openAuth()">CRIAR CONTA</button>
  </div>
</nav>

<header class="hero">
  <img class="hero-image" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Pôster de A Vila">
  <div class="hero-overlay"></div>
  <div class="hero-content">
    <div class="eyebrow">Uma experiência interativa</div>
    <h1>A <span>Vila</span></h1>
    <p>Entre na comunidade, conheça suas regras e observe os sinais. O que você realmente entendeu sobre o filme?</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="play()">Entrar na Vila</button>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="quizzes">
  <div class="section-head">
    <h2>Escolha seu desafio</h2>
    <p>Oito maneiras de explorar a história. Alguns desafios revelam detalhes importantes do enredo.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="grid" id="cards"></div>

  <section class="quiz-area" id="quiz" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="quiz-top"><h2 id="quiz-title">Quiz</h2><small id="counter"></small></div>
    <div id="spoiler-notice"></div>
    <div class="progress"><span id="progress"></span></div>
    <div class="question" id="question"></div>
    <div class="answers" id="answers"></div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback"></div>
    <div class="quiz-actions">
      <button class="btn" id="back" style="background:transparent;color:var(--gold)">← Voltar aos desafios</button>
      <button class="btn" id="next">Responder</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="ranking" id="ranking">
    <div class="section-head">
      <h2>Ranking da Vila</h2>
      <p>Veja quem já completou os desafios e suas melhores pontuações.</p>
      <p id="rankingStatus" role="status" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Conectando ao placar...</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ranking-box">
      <div class="rank-row head"><div>#</div><div>Jogador</div><div>Pontos</div></div>
      <div id="rankingRows"></div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<div class="auth" id="auth">
  <div class="auth-box">
    <h2>Entre na comunidade</h2>
    <p>Crie uma conta para jogar e participar do ranking.</p>
    <input id="name" placeholder="Nome de usuário">
    <input id="email" type="email" placeholder="E-mail">
    <input id="password" type="password" placeholder="Senha">
    <div class="auth-actions">
      <button class="btn" onclick="createAccount()">Criar conta</button>
      <button class="btn" onclick="closeAuth()" style="background:transparent;color:var(--gold)">Fechar</button>
    </div>
    <div class="auth-msg" id="authMsg"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<footer class="footer">A VILA · QUIZZES DE FÃS · EXPERIÊNCIA NÃO OFICIAL</footer>

2775%22%20cy%3D%22390%22%20r%3D%2255%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3C%2Fg%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%3Crect%20y%3D%22555%22%20width%3D%22900%22%20height%3D%2245%22%20fill%3D%22%230a100b%22%2F%3E%0A%20%20%20%20%3C%2Fsvg%3E",spoiler:true,qs:[
["What is revealed about the creatures?",["They are real supernatural beings","The threat is staged by the villagers themselves","They are animals from another planet","They are only Ivy's hallucinations"],1],
["In what era is the outside world actually living?",["18th century","19th century","Contemporary times","A distant future"],2],
["Why did the Elders create the isolated community?",["To protect the community from the outside world after traumatic experiences","To mine for resources","To hide a treasure","To train soldiers"],0]]}
];

const cards=document.getElementById('cards');
quizzes.forEach((q,i)=>{
  const a=document.createElement('article');
  a.className='card';
  a.innerHTML=`<img src="${q.img}" alt="Paisagem de floresta" loading="eager"><div class="card-body"><div class="num">DESAFIO 0${i+1}</div><h3>${q.title}</h3><p>${q.desc}</p><span class="tag">${q.tag}</span></div>`;
  a.onclick=()=>start(i);
  cards.appendChild(a);
});

let active=0,step=0,score=0,chosen=null,answered=false,completed=false;

function user(){return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("avilaUser")||"null")}
function openAuth(){document.getElementById("auth").classList.add("active");document.getElementById("authMsg").textContent=""}
function closeAuth(){document.getElementById("auth").classList.remove("active")}
function createAccount(){
  const n=document.getElementById("name").value.trim(),e=document.getElementById("email").value.trim(),p=document.getElementById("password").value;
  if(!n||!e||!p){document.getElementById("authMsg").textContent="Preencha todos os campos.";return}
  if(p.length<4){document.getElementById("authMsg").textContent="A senha precisa ter pelo menos 4 caracteres.";return}
  localStorage.setItem("avilaUser",JSON.stringify({name:n,email:e}));
  document.getElementById("authMsg").textContent="Conta criada!";
  setTimeout(()=>{closeAuth();goQuizzes()},500);
}
function play(){user()?goQuizzes():openAuth()}
function goQuizzes(){document.getElementById("quizzes").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"})}
function goRanking(){document.getElementById("ranking").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"})}

async function saveScoreRealtime(playerName, points, total, quizTitle){
  if(!supabaseClient){
    const scores=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("avilaScores")||"[]");
    scores.push({name:playerName,score:points,total,quiz:quizTitle});
    localStorage.setItem("avilaScores",JSON.stringify(scores));
    renderRankingLocal();
    return {ok:false,local:true,error:"Supabase não configurado"};
  }
  try {
    const {error}=await supabaseClient.from('scores').insert({name:playerName,score:points,total:total,quizTitle:quizTitle});
    if(error){
      console.error('Erro ao salvar pontuação no Supabase:',error);
      document.getElementById('rankingStatus').textContent='Erro ao salvar pontuação: '+error.message;
      return {ok:false,error:error.message};
    }
    return {ok:true};
  } catch(err) {
    console.error(err);
    document.getElementById('rankingStatus').textContent='Falha de conexão com o Supabase.';
    return {ok:false,error:String(err)};
  }
}
async function loadRanking(){
  const status=document.getElementById('rankingStatus');
  if(!supabaseClient){status.textContent='Modo local: configure o Supabase para compartilhar o ranking.';renderRankingLocal();return}
  status.textContent='Carregando ranking global...';
  try {
    const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('scores').select('name,score,total,quizTitle,created_at').order('score',{ascending:false}).limit(50);
    if(error){
      console.error('Erro ao carregar ranking:',error);
      status.textContent='Erro no ranking global: '+error.message;
      return;
    }
    renderRankingData(data||[]);
    status.textContent='Ranking global conectado · atualiza em tempo real';
  } catch(err) {
    console.error(err);
    status.textContent='Não foi possível conectar ao ranking global.';
  }
}
function renderRankingData(rows){
  const box=document.getElementById("rankingRows");box.innerHTML='';
  // Count each quiz block once per player, keeping the best result for that block.
  const players=new Map();
  rows.forEach(p=>{
    const name=String(p.name||'').trim();
    if(!name)return;
    const quiz=String(p.quizTitle||p.quiz||'Quiz');
    if(!players.has(name))players.set(name,{name,blocks:new Map(),score:0,total:0});
    const player=players.get(name);
    const old=player.blocks.get(quiz);
    const points=Number(p.score)||0;
    const total=Number(p.total)||0;
    if(!old || points>old.score) player.blocks.set(quiz,{score:points,total});
  });
  const ranking=[...players.values()].map(p=>{
    p.blocks.forEach(b=>{p.score+=b.score;p.total+=b.total});
    return p;
  }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score || b.total-a.total || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  if(!ranking.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="rank-row"><div>—</div><div>Nenhum jogador ainda</div><div>—</div></div>';return}
  ranking.slice(0,20).forEach((p,i)=>{
    const r=document.createElement("div");r.className="rank-row";
    r.innerHTML=`<div class="rank-number">${i+1}</div><div>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div><div>${p.score}/${p.total}</div>`;
    box.appendChild(r);
  });
}
function renderRankingLocal(){
  const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("avilaScores")||"[]");
  renderRankingData(s);
}
function escapeHtml(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>\'"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;',"'":'&#39;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));}

function start(i){
  if(!user()){openAuth();return}
  active=i;step=0;score=0;chosen=null;answered=false;completed=false;
  const q=quizzes[i];
  document.getElementById('quiz').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('quiz-title').textContent=q.title;
  document.getElementById('spoiler-notice').innerHTML=q.spoiler?'<div class="notice">⚠ Este desafio contém spoilers importantes sobre a história e o final. Continue apenas se já assistiu ao filme.</div>':'';
  show();
  document.getElementById('quiz').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
}

function show(){
  const q=quizzes[active],item=q.qs[step];
  chosen=null;answered=false;
  document.getElementById('counter').textContent=`${step+1} / ${q.qs.length}`;
  document.getElementById('progress').style.width=`${step/q.qs.length*100}%`;
  document.getElementById('question').textContent=item[0];
  document.getElementById('answers').innerHTML='';
  document.getElementById('feedback').textContent='';
  document.getElementById('next').textContent='Answer';
  item[1].forEach((v,i)=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='answer';b.textContent=String.fromCharCode(65+i)+'. '+v;
    b.onclick=()=>{if(answered)return;chosen=i;document.querySelectorAll('.answer').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));b.classList.add('selected')};
    document.getElementById('answers').appendChild(b);
  });
}

document.getElementById('next').onclick=async()=>{
  if(completed){start(active);return}
  const q=quizzes[active],item=q.qs[step];
  if(!answered){
    if(chosen===null){document.getElementById('feedback').textContent='Choose an option to continue.';return}
    answered=true;
    const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.answer')];
    buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=true;if(i===item[2])b.classList.add('correct');if(i===chosen&&chosen!==item[2])b.classList.add('wrong')});
    if(chosen===item[2])score++;
    document.getElementById('feedback').textContent=chosen===item[2]?'Correct answer!':'The correct answer is highlighted.';
    document.getElementById('next').textContent=step===q.qs.length-1?'See results':'Next';
    document.getElementById('progress').style.width=`${(step+1)/q.qs.length*100}%`;
    return;
  }
  if(step<q.qs.length-1){step++;show()}
  else{
    const u=user();
    const saveResult=await saveScoreRealtime(u.name,score,q.qs.length,q.title);
    document.getElementById('question').textContent=`Challenge complete! You got ${score} out of ${q.qs.length} correct.`;
    document.getElementById('answers').innerHTML='';
    document.getElementById('feedback').textContent=saveResult.ok?'Your score was saved to the global ranking.':(saveResult.local?'Your score was saved only on this device.':('Score could not be synced: '+(saveResult.error||'unknown error')));
    completed=true;
    await loadRanking();
    if(active < quizzes.length - 1){
      document.getElementById('next').textContent='Loading next block…';
      document.getElementById('feedback').textContent += ' Next block starts automatically…';
      setTimeout(()=>start(active+1),1800);
    } else {
      document.getElementById('question').textContent=`All challenges complete! Final block: ${score} out of ${q.qs.length} correct.`;
      document.getElementById('next').textContent='Back to quizzes';
      document.getElementById('next').onclick=()=>{completed=false;document.getElementById('quiz').classList.remove('active');goQuizzes()};
    }
  }
};

document.getElementById('back').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('quiz').classList.remove('active');goQuizzes()};

if(supabaseReady){
  supabaseClient.channel('scores-live')
    .on('postgres_changes',{event:'*',schema:'public',table:'scores'},()=>loadRanking())
    .subscribe((status,error)=>{
      if(status==='SUBSCRIBED'){document.getElementById('rankingStatus').textContent='Ranking global conectado · atualiza em tempo real';}
      else if(status==='CHANNEL_ERROR'||status==='TIMED_OUT'){console.error('Realtime:',status,error);document.getElementById('rankingStatus').textContent='Ranking pode carregar, mas o Realtime falhou. Confira a publicação supabase_realtime.';}
    });
}
loadRanking();
</script>
</body>
</html>
